description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans. It includes codecs, surrogates, and deep copiers for efficient serialization and cloning.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableSortedDictionary, converting to and from a surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate type containing serializable components of ImmutableSortedDictionary.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableSortedDictionary, supports shallow copying if possible.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts ImmutableSortedDictionary to its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ImmutableSortedDictionary, with optional handling for cyclic references.
